thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — metering.counts anomaly detected in ingest pipeline (eu-west). sudden drop in emitted token counts vs upstream emitter. alert threshold 30% deviation, current delta ~58%. tagging oncall.
oncall-alex: ACK. I'm jumping on this. any customer-visible flags yet?
sre-ryan: seeing emitter -> kafka ack but downstream aggregator applying a filter that dropped ~900k tokens in the last 20m. looks like a schema mismatch from a recent deploy to metering-emitter in eu-west-1.
billing-maya: are we seeing overage flags or delayed usage reports raised to orgs? any invoices affected?
eng-nina: quick check — dashboards show a shadow tally bump for a subset of customers (~5%) earlier, then total emit drops after 12:10Z. could be a routing mismatch to the shadow aggregator.
cs-lucas: got two customer DMs: one says they saw an 'overage alert' email at 12:18 UTC, then no new usage events for the last hour. they panicked.
oncall-alex: thanks @cs-lucas. prioritize customer comms: we should issue a short "we're investigating" to affected customers.
sre-ryan: reproducing locally: the emitter sends messages with header X-metering-version: 2.1 but aggregator expects 2.0 => payload parser drops token_count field. patch incoming.
eng-nina: pushing rollback of emitter 2.1 -> 2.0 to eu-west canary now. will monitor counts.
infra-bot: deploy start: rollback/meters-emitter/eu-west @ oncall-alex (job 64321).
oncall-alex: good. also, can we enable temporary replay of kafka topic meter-events-staging -> meter-aggregator? need to recover missing tokens for billing.
sre-ryan: plan: 1) rollback emitter in eu-west (in progress) 2) enable consumer fallback that treats missing token_count as 0 until parser fixed 3) schedule replay from topic offset 1,234,567 to 1,235,999. that will recover ~1.1M tokens.
billing-maya: for customer impact: any customers who got overage flags — hold automatic invoice generation and suppress escalation emails until we reconcile replay. also prepare a manual credit run if counts spike.
eng-nina: rollback complete, metrics converging back to baseline within 2 mins.
sre-ryan: running quick query on ClickHouse:
```
SELECT sum(token_count) FROM meter_aggregates WHERE ts >= '2026-03-18 12:00' AND region='eu-west';
```
pre-replay vs post-replay delta expected ~+1.1M. starting replay now (low QPS).
cs-lucas: posted interim note to affected customers: "We're aware of a metering discrepancy causing transient overage emails. We're pausing billing notifications while we reconcile. ETA ~2h." :white_check_mark:
oncall-alex: good comms. @billing-maya - can you create a support tag for customers with manual hold?
billing-maya: created tag "metering-reconcile-hold" and applied to 18 orgs flagged by CS. will hold invoice generation and mark for credit review.
sre-ryan: replay finished. running integrity check... aggregator confirms roughly +1.08M tokens consumed by replay.
eng-nina: running QA on parser fix for 2.1 -> patch v2.1.1 to tolerate unknown headers. will ship to canary after spike cooldown.
infra-bot: job 64322: kafka-replay completed (offsets 1234567-1235999).
sre-ryan: verification: shadow vs production tally within 1.2% now. alert thresholds back to normal.
oncall-alex: any lingering customer-visible flags?
cs-lucas: all affected customers received updated note, a few asked for confirmation once counts reconcile — will follow up individually.
billing-maya: flags cleared for 16/18 orgs after replay. 2 orgs still show mismatch, I'm opening support cases to investigate edge cases (custom ingest).
sre-ryan: root cause: deploy introduced stricter payload parsing that returned an error path dropping token_count when header mismatch occurred. postmortem items: add schema backward-compat checks to CI, add a canary metric for parser errors, and add an automated replay plan documented in runbook.
oncall-alex: thanks team. Incident status -> mitigated. leaving this thread open for postmortem notes and billing reconciliation confirmation.
eng-nina: adding postmortem draft to ops/docboard and tagging @oncall-alex for review.
billing-maya: I'll coordinate approved credits and confirm when invoices unpaused.
cs-lucas: following up with customers individually to confirm resolution.
incident-bot: Incident closed (after mitigation) — duration 46m. summary: token_count parser regression caused token undercount -> transient overage emails & delayed usage. mitigation: rollback, kafka replay, invoice hold.
note: single-thread slack export; messages in chronological order
